name: aoa-kag-fresh-owner-evidence-boundary
proof_question: Does an exact refreshed aoa-kag MCP read preserve owner-grounded evidence while refusing to imply durable memory, owner acceptance, admission, cross-organ benefit, effect authority, or rollback?
origin_need: The refreshed owner-scoped KAG projection now has exact storage identities, passing retrieval evaluation, a fresh signed canary, exact owner review, and bounded central packet review. The resulting cross-organ handoff needs a durable eval request that preserves every stronger authority boundary.
summary: Routes fresh KAG owner evidence and its memo candidate into aoa-evals without treating MCP reachability, candidate creation, or central source-contract support as acceptance or admission.
object_under_evaluation: fresh aoa-kag owner evidence boundary across KAG, memo, eval, and acceptance stages
expected_use_when: a fresh owner-grounded KAG read is handed to memo and eval contours
an agent must distinguish evidence, candidate memory, central proof, and owner acceptance
blind_spot_notes: does not prove durable memo landing or memory benefit
does not authorize registry admission, effects, or rollback
does not make MCP or the SDK the semantic owner of KAG, memo, or eval artifacts
